title: Duplicates
means: Two records holding one telephone number. Until you answer, two people are working one customer.
empty: No two records share a telephone number.
listLabel: Records that may be one customer
keepHint: {other} folds into this record. Its contacts, projects, quotations and activity log move across, nothing is deleted, and {rep} stops seeing the customer.
keepAndShareHint: {other} folds into this record, and {rep} stays on the customer: they read everything under it and keep their own contacts. The record itself does not change hands.
notTheSameHint: Both records stay exactly as they are, and this pair is never raised again.
foldedInto: This record was folded into {name}, held by {rep}.
